_about: Login transcripts of the pinned CLIs (Claude Code 2.1.311, Codex 0.164.0), captured on 28 Oct 2026 in a throwaway home (WP3.23): each CLI's own output through a pty, chunk by chunk, with the seconds since start. 'prompt' runs were stopped at the prompt; the others ran the real CLIs against local fake providers (a throwaway CA for Anthropic's hosts; Codex's --experimental_issuer), so no real sign-in happened. Every value is a placeholder: {url}, {state}, {code_challenge}, {client_id} and {user_code} are filled with synthetic values by the fake CLIs and the tests. Codex's link is its real one, https://auth.openai.com/codex/device (from the prompt run). 'input' marks where the pasted code was written.
